_doc: Example sender allowlist for email_research_senders.py. Copy to knowledge/email-research-senders.json (or point AGENT_EMAIL_SENDERS at your copy) and replace these fabricated senders with your own research newsletters. status: active | paused | sponsored.

senders.note: domain match covers every sender on it
paused senders stay listed for the record
sponsored senders are harvested but never picked as research
